text: なんじゃー　つかまえかたを　しらんのか！

structure.jp: つかまえかたを　しらんのか！
structure.en: you don't know how to catch them?!

patterns.name: 〜かた
patterns.explanation: かた stuck onto a verb stem means 'the way of doing it'. つかまえかた = 'how to catch'.

patterns.name: 〜ない
patterns.explanation: ん is an old-man way of saying ない, 'not'. しらん = 'don't know'.
